resources.string: Ana jiran sauya inda sauti zai fito
Yi magana da AI cikin sirri, kamar kiran waya.
Ƙaramin mai sarrafa Private Audio. Matsayi: %1$s. Abubuwan sarrafa kunnawa ko kashewa, faɗaɗawa da rufewa.

Private Audio ba ya tattara, rikodi ko aika tattaunawarku ko abin sauti.

Manhajar ba ta bukatar asusu ko shiga. Ba ta neman damar makirufo kuma ba ta amfani da nazari, talla ko sabis na rahoton crash. Private Audio ba ya neman izinin Intanet na Android kuma ba ya aika bayanai zuwa saba.

Private Audio yana lura ne kawai da yanayin fasaha da metadata na tsarin sautin Android da ake bukata don karkatar da sauti da bincike. Ba ya shiga cikin abin da kuka tattauna.

Ana adana saitunan manhaja a na'urarku kawai. Ana samarwa da sarrafa bayanan bincike a na'urar, kuma ana adana rahoto ne kawai idan kuka zabi adanawa. Rahoto na iya ƙunsar bayanan fasaha game da na'ura, sigar Android, karkatar da sauti da yanayin tsarin sauti, amma ba tattaunawa ko abin sauti ba.

An kashe ajiyar bayanan manhajar Android.
A yanzu, Private Audio yana bin harshen na\'urarka. An zaɓi Na asali.
Zaɓin harshe a cikin manhaja yana buƙatar Android 13 ko mafi sabo. Wannan na\'urar tana bin harshen tsarin.
Kashe allo idan wayar ta kusanci kunnenka
Yayin da Private Audio ke bunƙasa, ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka za su bayyana a nan.
Private Audio yana taimakawa wajen sauya sautin murya da ake tallafawa zuwa lasifikar kunne da ke cikin wayarka.
Ba a iya ajiye rahoton bincike ba.
Zaman sautin ya ƙare kafin a kammala tura sautin.
Private Audio bai iya fara tura sauti ba.
Private Audio bai iya shirya sautin sadarwa ba.
Ba a amince da buƙatar tura sauti zuwa lasifikar kunne ba.
Ba a iya kammala tura sauti ba.
